description: Composite skill that chains spiral time, calendar, routines, and upcoming bills into one daily briefing

system_context.engine_import: from engine.base import SkillBase, SkillRequest, SkillResponse

context.scaffold:
class DailyBriefingSkill(SkillBase):
    name = 'daily_briefing'
    version = '1.0'
    category = 'composite'
    description = 'Daily briefing combining spiral time, calendar, routines, and bills'
    triggers = ['good morning', 'daily briefing', 'brief me', 'start my day', 'morning report', 'whats today look like', 'what do i have today']
    cache_ttl = 300

    SUB_SKILLS maps skill module paths to class names

mandatory_patterns.no_database: This is a composite. No _get_conn, no psycopg2. Uses importlib to call sub-skills.
mandatory_patterns.import_pattern: import importlib; module = importlib.import_module('data.skill_name'); SkillClass = getattr(module, 'ClassName'); response = await SkillClass().run(request)
mandatory_patterns.skillresponse_signature: SkillResponse ONLY accepts: skill_name, data, summary, confidence, sources, error.

build_plan.instruction:
Write file skeleton. Imports: logging, importlib, engine.base. NO database imports. Class DailyBriefingSkill with attributes. Define SUB_SKILLS as class dict:

SUB_SKILLS = {
    'spiral_time': ('data.spiral_time', 'SpiralTimeSkill'),
    'calendar': ('data.query_calendar', 'QueryCalendarSkill'),
    'routines': ('data.query_routines', 'QueryRoutinesSkill'),
    'bills': ('data.query_bills_due', 'QueryBillsDueSkill'),
}

Methods: execute, _run_skill, _build_briefing. All 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _run_skill(self, module_path, class_name, request). Import module with importlib.import_module(module_path). Get class with getattr. Instantiate and run: response = await cls().run(request). Return response. Wrap in try/except, on error return SkillResponse(skill_name=class_name, error=str(e)).

Implement _build_briefing(self, results). Takes dict of {label: SkillResponse}. Build sections list. For each label in order ['spiral_time', 'calendar', 'routines', 'bills']: if response.ok and response.summary, append the summary. Join all sections with ' | '. If no sections have data, return 'Good morning. No briefing data available today.' Return the combined string.

Implement execute(). For each skill in SUB_SKILLS: call _run_skill and collect results in a dict. Call _build_briefing with the results dict. Collect all data from ok responses into merged_data dict keyed by label. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data=merged_data, summary=briefing, confidence=0.9, sources=['daily_briefing']). try/except.
Review. No database imports. importlib used correctly. All four sub-skills referenced. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
